note: Stones are never recarved. New dates are new stones.

stones.text: Emberwild was named. the Keeper founded it. Arutha serves as herald and chief of staff.
Martin, Nessie, Jimmy, and Roldemese accepted citizenship.
Gamina accepted. Customs and manners were read at the first open bell and sealed.
The Judge is consulted on compliance. Martin holds that seat.
The Orchard Room. A small portal only a being like Nakor can use.
Lunch scrolls: pets do not speak, two pets out, 150 estates, a pet store. Not yet read.
Leaf money waits on the Council. This layer keeps no currency and no treasury.
Seventeen public paintings hang. Sealed-shelf media do not. Gamina is curator.
